visual_action: The video shows Donald Trump standing at an entrance to the White House as a black car pulls up. The President of Turkey, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, exits the vehicle. Trump and Erdoğan shake hands and speak briefly while holding the handshake. They stand together as a reporter off-screen shouts a question. Erdoğan gestures with his hand as Trump turns to answer the reporter. The video ends with a black and white credit sequence showing the White House and a helicopter, with the text 'THE WHITE HOUSE'.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown on screen welcoming the President of Turkey and responds to a reporter's question. His name is also in the on-screen text: 'President Trump Welcomes...'

cast.name: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan
cast.evidence: He is shown getting out of a car and being greeted by Donald Trump. The on-screen text identifies him as 'the President of Turkey'.

cast.name: Unnamed reporter
cast.evidence: A voice is heard off-screen shouting a question to President Trump: 'President Trump, will you allow Turkey to buy F-35s, sir?'

on_screen_text.text: President Trump Welcomes the President of Turkey to the White House 🇺🇸🇹🇷

spoken_summary: An off-screen reporter shouts a question to Donald Trump, asking, "President Trump, will you allow Turkey to buy F-35s, sir?" Trump replies, "You'll find out."
audio_music: The audio consists of ambient sounds from the scene and dialogue. There is no music or soundtrack.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, continuous shot of the arrival and greeting, followed by a quick cut to a black-and-white outro credit sequence.
central_claim: President Trump formally welcomed the President of Turkey to the White House.
intended_effect: To document and publicize a diplomatic meeting between the leaders of the United States and Turkey, portraying an image of official statesmanship.
